verdict.rationale: xAI documents a model versioning scheme: pinned versioned model IDs, plus `<modelname>` aliased to latest stable and `<modelname>-latest` aliased to latest. It also handles lifecycle through dated retirement guides that give advance notice, list the retired slugs, and auto-redirect them to `grok-4.3` so existing code keeps resolving. The evidence shows per-event migration guides rather than a standing written policy, and the auto-redirect means a pinned slug can silently become a different model. Missing for 10: a general deprecation policy with committed minimum notice periods, a documented API-surface versioning and compatibility policy beyond the `/v1` endpoint, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how retirements played out.
